name: xclip-8fps
notes: D3 XCLIP-16 branch with the pinned microsoft/xclip-base-patch16 checkpoint (native num_frames=8, 16 inputs form two eight-frame groups). Same 26 previously examined sources and sampling as temporal-8fps. No calibration or threshold decision. Preserve author BGR preprocessing, L2 discrepancy and sample standard deviation. Direct source decoding and centered windows differ from upstream random-window JPEG extraction. See configs/xclip-ranking-policy.md. A feature encoder comparison, not a new holdout or full paper reproduction.
